FinFilings AI - Phase 1 SSE2 kernel disassembly (raw)
=======================================================
Captured 2026-10-30 from the final tree. go1.27.1 linux/amd64, GOAMD64=v1.
`go test` links its ephemeral binary with -s (no symbol table), so an
unstripped package test binary is built with -c and disassembled. The same
check runs automatically as TestSSE2KernelsDisassembly (amd64, !purego,
skipped with -short).

Kernels exist ONLY for PFOR bit widths 8 and 16 on amd64 (without the purego
tag). All other widths, the tail of any block that does not fill a whole
vector group, and all other GOARCHes use scalar Go.

$ go test -c -o /tmp/ffindex-final.test ./pkg/index/ && go tool objdump -s 'index\.(un)?pack(8|16)SSE2' /tmp/ffindex-final.test
